description: ORGANIZATION IS LINE SEQUENTIAL (ISO §2023:12.4.5.10.3 GR2) — the line sequential file organization, introduced 2023
citation: ISO §2023:12.4.5.10.3 GR2; §2023:9.1.7.2 splits sequential files into record- and line-delimited types
vcr: 2023 introduction — the Foreword's list of main changes over ISO/IEC 1989:2014 names "Line Sequential file organization" (Annex E carries no item for it); no VCR row
source:
IDENTIFICATION DIVISION.
PROGRAM-ID. VMLS.
ENVIRONMENT DIVISION.
INPUT-OUTPUT SECTION.
FILE-CONTROL.
    SELECT F ASSIGN TO "vmls" ORGANIZATION IS LINE SEQUENTIAL.
DATA DIVISION.
FILE SECTION.
FD F.
01 R PIC X(10).
PROCEDURE DIVISION.
MAIN.
    OPEN OUTPUT F.
    MOVE "A" TO R.
    WRITE R.
    CLOSE F.
    STOP RUN.
